statement: The Epoch Capabilities Index gain in 2027 is < 50% of its 2025 gain (Epoch AI; 2028-01)
status_at_phase_end: Data gap: the composite capabilities index named in the indicator was not published during 2024, and neither reference year (2025, 2027) had occurred. Only per-benchmark comparisons existed.

items.summary: No composite capabilities index existed during the phase; the compute tracker published per-benchmark comparisons (e.g. open vs closed model lags), which cannot be used to compute the indicator's year-on-year index gain.
items.detail: Epoch AI's 2024 work compared models benchmark by benchmark (e.g. 'Open vs. closed AI: How behind are open models?', early November 2024, opened via web_extract this run). The Epoch Capabilities Index appeared only after the phase window and is excluded under the as-of rule.
